title: USF Evidence Envelope Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for the common evidence envelope across evidence kinds (rank-4 runtime-proof-evidence). Each envelope declares its evidence kind (evidence-kinds), source reference, freshness (commit-pinned), and — where the evidence depends on them — provider mode (provider-modes) and environment (environment-classes). A generated-report envelope MUST reference the evidence it summarises and MUST NOT be treated as raw evidence. Governs the ontology concepts Evidence and Generated Report. Overclaim and missing-evidence fail-closed checks are validator-deferred per schema-authoring-standard §24. lifecycleState draft; not active.

allOf.$comment: A generated-report envelope must reference the underlying evidence it summarises (Authority Model §2.7).
Normalised evidence must retain a reference to the raw evidence it reshapes.
